draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Chalakudy! This town on the Chalakudy River is the base camp for Athirappilly and Vazhachal Falls. Right in town there's a Holy Land, with statues of scenes from the Bible.
draft.hungryLine: Chalakudy is a handy stop on the highway, so grab a simple Kerala meal in town before heading out to the falls.

moodReplies.show-me-around: St. Mary's Forane Church and the Holy Land beside it are just a 5 minute walk, and the Regional Science Centre is about 15 minutes away.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Kalabhavan Mani Memorial Park has playgrounds and paths to walk, best in the early morning or late afternoon.
moodReplies.surprise-me: The Pietà is one of the big draws at Holy Land Chalakudy, which is also a Marian pilgrimage centre.

spots.name: Holy Land Chalakudy
spots.detail: 5 min walk · Bible scenes in statues, from the Nativity to the Resurrection

spots.name: St. Mary's Syro-Malabar Forane Church, Chalakudy
spots.detail: 5 min walk · Head church of 16 parishes in the area

spots.name: Regional Science Centre, Chalakudy
spots.detail: 15 min walk · Science museum, great with kids

legends.title: St. Sebastian's feast
legends.body: Every year on January 29 and 30, Perambra just north of town celebrates St. Sebastian's feast. Crowds come from all around.

legends.title: St. Antony's feast
legends.body: Perambra also keeps St. Antony's feast every June. It's one of the traditions the little town is known for.

tips.title: Hit the park early or late.
tips.body: Kalabhavan Mani Memorial Park is best visited in the early morning or late afternoon.

tips.title: Use town as your base.
tips.body: Chalakudy is the base camp for Athirappilly and Vazhachal Falls, so stock up here before you head out.

story.title: Retreats begin
story.body: The Vincentian Congregation started running retreats in parishes across Kerala. It later led to the Divine Retreat Centre at Muringoor.

story.title: Farming research
story.body: The Agronomic Research Station was set up in Chalakudy and taken over by Kerala Agricultural University. It now works on organic fertigation.

story.title: A church centre
story.body: Chalakudy became a forane of the new Irinjalakuda diocese in 1978. The Divine Retreat Centre at Muringoor opened in 1987.

story.title: Science for everyone
story.body: The Regional Science Centre opened to bring science to the public, especially children.

story.title: Gateway to the falls
story.body: Chalakudy sits on National Highway 544, about 47 km north of Kochi. Most visitors pass through on the way to the waterfalls.
